Modern armed conflicts have a tendency to cluster together and spread geographically. However, the geography of most conflicts remains under-studied. We demonstrate the indicator in North and West Africa between 1997 to 2019 to show that it can clarify how conflicts can spread from place to place and how the geography of conflict changes over time.
